name: District
description: District is a dining-out, movies, and live event ticketing platform operating as a segment of Eternal Ltd (formerly Zomato).

stock.note: Reflects parent company Eternal Ltd (ETERNAL.NS), not District specifically.

marketing_spend.derivation: Modeled by taking District's reported 9.8% revenue contribution against Eternal Ltd's FY26 consolidated revenue (₹20,243 crore, yielding ~₹1,984 crore segment revenue) and applying a typical consumer tech/ticketing marketing-to-revenue ratio of 15% to 25%.

business_updates.headline: District (Going-Out) accounts for 9.8% of Eternal Ltd's adjusted revenue mix in Q4 FY26
